title: What to pick at nasi campur and nasi kandar shops when you want to lose weight
intro: Nasi campur and nasi kandar are the go-to lunch for many working people. You can keep eating rice. The secret is how you build your plate: enough rice, protein that's not too oily, and lots of vegetables. The calories below are estimates.

best.name: White rice, 1 scoop
best.why: Keep eating rice, just one scoop. Enough energy for afternoon work.

best.name: Ikan bakar or ikan asam pedas (1 medium fish)
best.why: High protein with little oil. The best choice at most shops.

best.name: Ayam masak merah, 1 piece (skin removed)
best.why: Still tasty, and removing the skin saves a lot of fat.

best.name: Mixed vegetables or kangkung goreng belacan
best.why: Fibre helps you feel full. Take 2 types of vegetables if you can.

best.name: Boiled egg or gulai telur, 1 egg
best.why: Cheap protein that's easy to add to your plate.

best.name: Vegetable soup or sup tulang (clear broth)
best.why: Clear broth helps you feel full without many calories.

careful.name: Kuah campur banjir (3 types of gravy)
careful.why: Curry and santan gravies have hidden oil. Flooding your rice with gravy can add calories like a small meal.

careful.name: Ayam goreng berempah, 1 piece
careful.why: Deep-fried until crispy and soaks up oil, especially the skin.

careful.name: Rendang daging (3-4 pieces)
careful.why: Rich in santan and oil. Tasty, so take just a little for flavour.

careful.name: Sotong goreng tepung
careful.why: The batter and oil add far more calories than the squid itself.

careful.name: Full nasi kandar (mountain of rice, fried chicken, egg, kuah banjir)
careful.why: All high-calorie items on one plate. Fine once in a while, not as a daily routine.

hacks: Take vegetables first before other dishes, so half your plate is veg.
Say 'nasi sikit' (less rice) or 'satu senduk sahaja' (just one scoop).
Ask for 'kuah sikit' (less gravy) or 'kuah asing' (gravy on the side) so you control it yourself.
Pick just one main protein dish, not two or three.
Fried dish? Remove the skin or batter, and balance it with a dish in clear broth.
drink: Plain water or teh o ais kosong (iced black tea, no sugar). Sirap and regular teh ais are high in sugar, so save them for the weekend.

faq.q: Do I have to stop eating rice to lose weight?
faq.a: No need. One scoop of rice with enough protein and vegetables is already balanced. What matters is your total calories for the day.

faq.q: I love nasi kandar. How can I eat it without feeling guilty?
faq.a: Pick fish or skinless chicken, less rice, less gravy, and add vegetables. If you want the full version, plan it for once in a while and eat lighter at other meals.
